The variant is an editorial argument about both names and construction terms. The direct Arukh gives vetina and marks Vestini parenthetically. The checked Bavli and Rashi keep personal name readings. The material senaim stays transliterated, with the Arukh’s interpretation available.
The negative is the Mussaf’s claim within its argument. Heilprin answers with Yusta and Yustini in the Yerushalmi. The direct passages support the name forms.

The teacher-student inference and the equivalence of the three forms remain attributed. Rashi calls Vastini a student. The Yerushalmi relates Yusta’s transmission and Yustini’s encounter, without independent identity adjudication.

The letter Yod reading still needs a directly collated witness. The letter Vav entry was read directly. The checked digital second-essay index stops at Vav, and the other edition fragments did not supply the Yod notice.
The digital halakhah division differs from Heilprin’s. The exact discussion is in Jerusalem Bava Batra 8:5 and has a parallel in Ketubot 9:1.
